name: bytebot-workspace
description: Bytebot AI Agent Workspace - Multi-Package Monorepo
author: Bytebot AI

scripts.install:packages: pnpm run install:shared && pnpm run install:agent && pnpm run install:ui && pnpm run install:bytebotd
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:packages && pnpm run clean:coverage
scripts.clean:packages: pnpm run clean:shared && pnpm run clean:agent && pnpm run clean:ui && pnpm run clean:bytebotd
scripts.clean:shared: cd packages/shared && rm -rf node_modules dist coverage
scripts.clean:agent: cd packages/bytebot-agent && rm -rf node_modules dist coverage
scripts.clean:bytebotd: cd packages/bytebotd && rm -rf node_modules dist coverage
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:parallel
scripts.build:parallel: concurrently "pnpm run build:agent" "pnpm run build:ui" "pnpm run build:bytebotd"
scripts.test:packages: pnpm run test:shared && pnpm run test:agent && pnpm run test:ui && pnpm run test:bytebotd
scripts.test:parallel: concurrently "pnpm run test:shared" "pnpm run test:agent" "pnpm run test:ui" "pnpm run test:bytebotd"
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:collect && pnpm run test:coverage:aggregate
scripts.test:coverage:collect: concurrently "pnpm run test:coverage:shared" "pnpm run test:coverage:agent" "pnpm run test:coverage:ui" "pnpm run test:coverage:bytebotd"
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:integration:prepare && pnpm run test:integration:execute
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && pnpm run test:e2e:execute
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:ci:validate && pnpm run test:ci:execute
scripts.test:ci:execute: pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.lint:packages: concurrently "pnpm run lint:shared" "pnpm run lint:agent" "pnpm run lint:ui" "pnpm run lint:bytebotd"
scripts.format:packages: concurrently "pnpm run format:shared" "pnpm run format:agent" "pnpm run format:ui" "pnpm run format:bytebotd"
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:shared" "pnpm run dev:agent" "pnpm run dev:ui" "pnpm run dev:bytebotd"
scripts.start:production: concurrently "pnpm run start:agent" "pnpm run start:ui" "pnpm run start:bytebotd"
scripts.deps:update:packages: concurrently "pnpm run deps:update:shared" "pnpm run deps:update:agent" "pnpm run deps:update:ui" "pnpm run deps:update:bytebotd"
scripts.security:audit:packages: concurrently "pnpm run security:audit:shared" "pnpm run security:audit:agent" "pnpm run security:audit:ui" "pnpm run security:audit:bytebotd"
